description: This PHP file defines the PerformanceReviewDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manipulate and access performance review entities, including setting employee and job title references, retrieving review reviewers, formatting date fields, and getting review status names.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for PerformanceReview entities providing additional helper methods for setting references and retrieving data in formatted ways.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a PerformanceReview object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee reference in the performance review entity by employee number.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the job title reference in the performance review entity by job title ID.

methods.name: getSupervisorReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the supervisor reviewer from the performance review.

methods.name: getEmployeeReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the employee reviewer from the performance review.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted due date of the performance review.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the review period.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the review period.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted completion date of the performance review.

methods.name: getStatusName
methods.description: Returns the string label for the current status of the performance review.
